findings: The fixed public repository ID1446122118 controls the rule; no repository name, candidate policy field, PR label or model alias selects it. Existing validation requires an integer repository ID and exact authenticated binding.

Operator ledger export first verifies signed history/checkpoint, target binding, latest freeze/report and non-authorship. It then derives eligibility from the observed run referenced by the accepted report. No candidate model field overrides this.

The schema2 decision path checks every required application, including coverage, every finding disposition and complete assembly. No non-substantive or repair exemption is introduced. Existing exact target/dependency hashes and author exclusions remain unchanged.

Event ingestion, authorship records, objections, negative reports and historical reports remain unrestricted by model. Ineligible favorable reports cannot be exported as required public acceptance but remain preserved evidence.

Both live context dependency maps pin the helper and changed validators. Fork generation equivalence test remains enforced. Active controller files and its approved revision were not changed by this review.

Public docs correctly distinguish contributions from acceptance authority, require non-authors and exact revisions, preserve objections and private no-ruleset scope, and mark runtime activation as separate pending evidence.

Trust remains protected controller/operator observation, not provider-signed proof of actual serving-model identity. The offline structural function does not become authenticated merely because its supplied model field passes.
